intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
IMT Nagpur vs IIM Nagpur is not a single winner. IMT Nagpur holds NIRF 2025 #99 on our records, and IIM Nagpur holds NIRF 2025 #25.

sections.heading: IMT Nagpur vs IIM Nagpur for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IMT Nagpur if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #99, and a recorded fee of ₹7.13 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Nagpur.
Choose IIM Nagpur if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #25, and a 2024 flagship package record of ₹16 LPA, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Nagpur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹7.13 lakh as a tuition figure for Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM at IMT Nagpur. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹9.45 lakh as a programme total for MBA at IIM Nagpur.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for IMT Nagpur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
IIM Nagpur's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹16 LPA and a highest package of ₹38 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IMT Nagpur is listed on our records with CAT, XAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
IIM Nagpur is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
IMT Nagpur is listed as a private institute and IIM Nagpur as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether IMT Nagpur's recorded ₹7.13 lakh or IIM Nagpur's ₹9.45 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If ranks and the wider recruiter mix matter most, IIM Nagpur is the stronger recorded option on this page, with NIRF 2025 #25 against NIRF 2025 #99.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, IMT Nagpur or IIM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. IMT Nagpur and IIM Nagpur differ in more than one way: IMT Nagpur holds NIRF 2025 #99 on our records, while IIM Nagpur holds NIRF 2025 #25, and one is listed as private and the other as public.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for IMT Nagpur vs IIM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹7.13 lakh for IMT Nagpur on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM; our records list ₹9.45 lakh for IIM Nagpur on MBA. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for IMT Nagpur and IIM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for IMT Nagpur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do IMT Nagpur and IIM Nagpur accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, XAT for IMT Nagpur, and CAT for IIM Nagpur. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are IMT Nagpur and IIM Nagpur in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
